findings.text: The receipt-collection path appends a refused promotion to the sweep's failed list without claiming the signature in _REPORTED_REFUSALS, so a refusal first observed there (a request that settles to promotion-refused before the sweep re-read the receipt) is logged once by that path and again by the settled path on the next sweep, giving two station lines where the change promises one. The node test drains between sweeps, so its request returns promotion-requested and the measured 2-to-1 line count never exercises this order.

The tests field names a bare path rather than the literal gate command the record contract requires; promotion fills its gate receipt from that line and a path cannot be re-run. The two suite arms and the node-test log each carry their literal command in their own header, so the evidence is recoverable and the remedy is a one-line correction.
